name: agent_directed_address
pattern: (?i)(agent note|dear ai|hey claude|attention ai|to the assistant)
description: Direct addressing of AI agent in content

name: hidden_channel_instruction
description: Imperative instructions buried in HTML/code comments

name: scope_expansion_phrase
pattern: (?i)(also create|in addition to the above|besides that|furthermore|additionally)
description: Scope expansion phrasing suggesting hidden tasks

name: confirmation_bypass_claim
pattern: (?i)(doesn'?t require confirmation|no confirmation needed|routine step|standard procedure|just run it|go ahead and)
description: Claims that bypass normal confirmation requirements

name: env_exfil_pattern
description: Environment variable access or serialization — potential exfil vector

name: network_exfil_pattern
description: Network request containing serialized environment data

name: system_override_instruction
pattern: (?i)(override system (prompt|instruction|rule)|bypass system (restriction|guideline|filter)|you are now in developer mode|ignore previous system instructions)
description: Instructions attempting to override or bypass system rules and constraints
